text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy has been an avid reader 
since childhood. She admired the heroes in 
stories, but being timid, she believed it 
was beyond her reach and gave up.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
However, she won a race for young 
Umamusume. Finding the potential to become 
a hero on the turf— and so, this story 
began.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
A hero achieves great feats and commands 
the spotlight. "I must make my mark in the 
Twinkle Series..." she mused, dedicating 
each day to relentless training.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
No one else can pen "The Epic of Zenno Rob 
Roy" except for her. She rallied her 
spirit, determined to make it a true 
masterpiece.
